kesan: DXY di SUPPLY M15 · ditolak → menyokong GOLD naik
teks: DXY M15 sedang retest SUPPLY M15 (103.830–103.880), iaitu zon tempat DXY jatuh laju malam tadi sekitar 22:30.
Candle terakhir masuk ke zon sampai 103.846, kemudian ditolak ke 103.825, iaitu di bawah zon semula.
Struktur: low 103.781 → 103.795 (higher low), high 103.841. Garis hijau RII Elliott membentuk corong mengembang, jadi pergerakan boleh jadi besar ke mana-mana arah.
Kalau DXY terus ditolak dari SUPPLY dan turun ke DEMAND M15 (103.730–103.769), itu menyokong Gold naik.
Kalau DXY tembus dan tutup di atas 103.880, dolar kuat dan Gold mungkin tertekan. Setup SELL Gold jadi lebih kuat.
teks_en: The dollar index on the fifteen minute chart is retesting its M15 supply zone, 103.830 to 103.880, where it dropped hard last night around ten thirty.
The last candle pushed into the zone up to 103.846, then was rejected back to 103.825, below the zone.
Structure: a higher low from 103.781 to 103.795, and a high at 103.841, inside a widening wedge on the Elliott lines. A big move either way is possible.
If the dollar keeps getting rejected from supply and falls toward M15 demand, 103.730 to 103.769, that supports gold moving higher.
If the dollar breaks and closes above 103.880, the dollar is strong and gold may come under pressure, making gold sell setups stronger.

berita.teks: Indeks dolar sentuh paras tertinggi 19 bulan pada 19 Nov. Dalam carta H1 hari ini, DXY ditolak dari zon 104.50–104.62 dan sedang menurun, sesuatu yang membantu Gold.
berita.en: The dollar index touched a nineteen month high on the nineteenth of November. On today's one hour chart it was rejected from 104.50 to 104.62 and is moving lower, which helps gold.
